instruction: Download the ticket for my flight to Santorini this weekend from gmail into the "~/documents/personal/" folder of my file system.
notes: Two apps are needed: gmail (to find the flight-ticket email and download its attachment) and file_system (its access token is required by gmail.download_attachment). Static init facts encode that a thread matching the Santorini query contains the email whose attachment is the ticket for the flight this weekend (current date 2023-05-18, Thursday, so the weekend is May 20-21); the agent must verify destination and date from the email body before downloading. The chain show_inbox_threads -> show_thread -> show_email discovers the thread, email and attachment ids (known-id over a shared record supertype). The goal demands exactly one download of the ticket attachment into ~/documents/personal/ (no other file-system or gmail changes), matching the evaluation which expects a single added file under that directory whose content is the Santorini weekend ticket. supervisor-complete-task takes the attachment and path as non-API record parameters so its precondition equals the task-specific goal, and it is forced to be last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action.
